claimRule: No layer inherits success from a proxy. In particular, encrypted import and a local MCP process do not prove continuation safety, production authentication, ChatGPT registration, or a fresh-chat tool call.

layers.evidence: A separate authorized process recovered the complete approved source, human-gold baseline, later correction source, structured state, and correction diff exactly. Private hashes and lengths remain only in the external private receipt.
All six owner-supplied recent turns and the exact pending candidate round-tripped without paraphrase; the candidate remains pending_audit and is not transcript history.

The real vault exposed no sampled plaintext and used mode-0600 files, a mode-0700 root, case-scoped bearer authorization before key acquisition, and the explicitly non-production development_external_file provider.

Public synthetic tests cover a source larger than the previous single-read ceiling, mixed line endings, Unicode, deterministic chunk manifests, exact restart reconstruction, and gap/duplicate/tamper rejection.

A separate local MCP process returned exact authorized source, candidate, recent episode, and provenance-targeted older source; unauthorized access returned no payload; bootstrap returned CASE_NOT_CONTINUATION_SAFE.

The supplied material contains one complete user-assistant exchange. Three are required. Two additional genuine complete historical exchanges must be appended; absent replies must not be invented and the pending candidate must not be counted as sent.
Production auth/key integration, HTTPS or an approved secure tunnel, OAuth registration, ChatGPT connection, and a newly created chat tool call are not verified.
The audit is intentionally deferred until the real continuation gate and fresh-ChatGPT retrieval are both green.

Only generic code, synthetic tests, public-safe operational receipts, and owner-authorized opaque IDs are in the candidate tree. Real source, secrets, private manifests, and private-derived hashes remain outside Git.

Focused private continuity passed 11/11; affected context, audit, UI, and private tests passed 34/34; the full Node 24 suite passed 1034/1034; graph regressions passed 29/29; therapy lessons passed 5/5; repository audit and publication audit passed; and npm run verify completed with PASS.

PR #49 was created from codex/private-case-import-20260909 as draft, open, and unmerged. Exact-head hosted results are external evidence and must be read from the current GitHub head rather than self-attested by a commit.
